criteria.name: Non-text Content
criteria.evidence: 425 image instances have alt attributes;32 empty alternatives require contextual equivalence review. No pixel-level inspection; see alt-text-headings notes.

criteria.name: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.evidence: Final HTML inventory contains no audio/video/embed content; administrative screenshots are images.

criteria.name: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.evidence: No prerecorded synchronized media found.

criteria.name: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.evidence: No prerecorded synchronized media found.

criteria.name: Captions (Live)
criteria.evidence: No live synchronized media found.

criteria.name: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.evidence: No prerecorded video found.

criteria.name: Info and Relationships
criteria.evidence: FORM-SEARCH-DUPLICATE-LABEL-TARGET; ARIA-NAV-CURRENT-001. Browser label associations and accessibility-tree properties verified.

criteria.name: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Source and rendered heading/main/list order reviewed across 149 content paths; no visual reorder defect identified. Native RTL screen-reader reading remains recommended.

criteria.name: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Source/content instructions and shared control text inspected; no instruction relying only on shape, position, colour or sound was established.

criteria.name: Orientation
criteria.evidence: Narrow/wide viewport inspection completed; physical device rotation/orientation restrictions were not explicitly verified.

criteria.name: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.evidence: Public inputs are search queries and free-text feedback, not fields collecting enumerated personal-information purposes.

criteria.name: Use of Color
criteria.evidence: Contrast and state styling reviewed; current navigation information is already captured under 1.3.1. Comprehensive independent colour-only content review remains required.

criteria.name: Audio Control
criteria.evidence: No automatically playing audio found.

criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.evidence: CONTRAST-001 and CONTRAST-002: measured light-theme version-badge/panel link contrast below 4.5:1; light/dark axe sweeps complete.

criteria.name: Resize Text
criteria.evidence: Responsive viewport inspection is not actual 200% text-only enlargement/browser zoom; native zoom remains pending.

criteria.name: Images of Text
criteria.evidence: Instructional CMS screenshots depict the interface under discussion; no nonessential images-of-text failure established, but pixel-level/content-equivalence review excluded.

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: REFLOW-001: long unbreakable translated release heading causes horizontal scrolling at 320 CSSpx. See playwright-scanner responsive evidence.

criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
criteria.evidence: CONTRAST-003: theme switch boundary/thumb disappear in Chromium forced-colors emulation; native Windows High Contrast follow-up required.

criteria.name: Text Spacing
criteria.evidence: Text-spacing override sweep completed on 153 successful HTML addresses. Overflow retained as supporting reflow evidence; clipping/content-loss interpretation and native browser confirmation remain required.

criteria.name: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.evidence: TOOLTIP-FEEDBACK-NOT-HOVERABLE: pointer cannot move into feedback tooltip without its dismissal; runtime pointer sequence confirmed.

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Keyboard navigator exercised skip link, navigation, theme, copy/language dropdowns, search, contents links and feedback controls. No keyboard-inoperable control found in tested sequences.

criteria.name: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Native links and dropdowns remain escapable; search Escape exits and restores trigger. Mobile overlay obscures focus but does not create an inescapable keyboard trap.

criteria.name: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.evidence: No global single-character guide-site shortcuts found; shortcuts described in documentation belong to the Wagtail admin, outside this website flow.

criteria.name: Timing Adjustable
criteria.evidence: No public task time limit found; debounce and result-animation delays do not impose a user completion deadline.

criteria.name: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.evidence: No identified automatically moving/blinking/scrolling content continuing beyond five seconds or recurring automatic updates requiring controls.

criteria.name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Scoped source and interactive preference checks identified no flashing content; no flash-frequency measurement was necessary for identified content.

criteria.name: Bypass Blocks
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: First Tab exposes skip link; activating it and pressing Tab proceeds to main-content link in Chromium.

criteria.name: Page Titled
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: All 153 successful HTML URLs have descriptive topic titles; localized copies sharing a topic title are not automatically failures. Search/404 titles also identify purpose.

criteria.name: Focus Order
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Keyboard and mocked feedback sequences preserve useful next sequential destinations; removal temporarily puts activeElement onBODY but a separate order failure was not established.

criteria.name: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Final link inventory reviewed; contents/heading context supplies section-link purpose. Broken destinations are functional advisory findings, not automatic purpose failures.

criteria.name: Multiple Ways
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Public documentation is discoverable through shared navigation, section listings, search and article cross-links.

criteria.name: Headings and Labels
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Topics/headings and form/control names identify their purpose; skip levels or Happy/Unhappy wording were not automatically classified as AA failures.

criteria.name: Focus Visible
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Inspected keyboard targets receive 2 px solid focus outlines. Mobile focus obscuration is separately confirmed under 2.4.11.

criteria.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.evidence: KEYBOARD-MOBILE-OVERLAY-FOCUS: open mobile navigation completely covers focused background theme/copy/language controls.

criteria.name: Pointer Gestures
criteria.evidence: No multipoint/path-based gesture needed for guide-site tasks.

criteria.name: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Scoped source uses native click activation for links/buttons; no essential action triggered solely on pointerdown was found.

criteria.name: Label in Name
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Native text buttons/links derive names from labels; image-only feedback/search buttons have names. No definite visible-text/name mismatch identified.

criteria.name: Motion Actuation
criteria.evidence: No guide-site feature requires device or user motion.

criteria.name: Dragging Movements
criteria.evidence: No drag operation required in public guide controls; dragging instructions concern separate Wagtail admin functionality.

criteria.name: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.evidence: Full 320 px axe sweep found no target-size violation, but every target/spacing and exception was not manually measured; automated absence alone is insufficient.

criteria.name: Language of Page
criteria.evidence: LANG-SHARED-001: search and discovered 404 documents render empty lang because page locale is unavailable.

criteria.name: Language of Parts
criteria.evidence: LANG-UNTRANSLATED-PARTS-001: substantial English fallback paragraphs inherit French/Icelandic/Portuguese/Arabic document language without lang=en.

criteria.name: On Focus
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Inspected focus sequences do not navigate/submit/change context merely on focus.

criteria.name: On Input
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Typing search updates local results; submission uses Enter/button. Theme state changes do not navigate to another context.

criteria.name: Consistent Navigation
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Shared header/navigation source and cross-page inventory retain recurring navigation relative order within each locale.

criteria.name: Consistent Identification
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Recurring search, copy, theme and feedback functions use shared templates and naming within locales.

criteria.name: Consistent Help
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Shared footer help/improvement resources and feedback appear in consistent relative positions on applicable pages.

criteria.name: Error Identification
criteria.evidence: Feedback success mocked safely; production validation/error responses not induced. JS console-only catches and unchecked HTTP response need failure-path verification.

criteria.name: Labels or Instructions
criteria.status: no issue found in tested scope
criteria.evidence: Search/feedback expose purpose labels; no additional required-field instructions identified. Broken explicit label association is already reported under 1.3.1.

criteria.name: Error Suggestion
criteria.evidence: Search/feedback error recovery and actionable suggestions need controlled failure-path tests; production failures were not deliberately induced.

criteria.name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.evidence: No legal/financial commitment, test submission or exposed deletion/modification of previously stored personal user data found in public flows.

criteria.name: Redundant Entry
criteria.evidence: No multistep process requiring repeat entry of previously supplied information identified.

criteria.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.evidence: No public guide authentication flow included; admin authentication requires a separately scoped audit.

criteria.name: Name, Role, Value
criteria.evidence: MODAL-ACCESSIBLE-NAME; ARIA-THEME-STATE-001; ARIA-MOBILE-POPUP-001. DOM and Chromium accessibility-tree evidence support missing/misleading semantics.

criteria.name: Status Messages
criteria.evidence: LIVE-001, LIVE-002 and LIVE-003: search counts, clipboard options success and feedback acknowledgement lack status semantics; native spoken announcements remain untested.
